environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer (ALB). The ALB has AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached with two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not blocking, just logging), CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING in BLOCK mode; (2) Priority 1: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in default BLOCK action, sensitivity level set to HIGH via SqliMatchStatement sensitivity override in the WebACL rule JSON. The WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch but this is observability only. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and the SQLite database is mounted on an EFS volume with encryption at rest enabled.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL
